story-context.title: Hardening + End-to-End UAT
story-context.epic: Epic 5: Form Builder Readiness + Review & Publishing
story-context.business-context: We have completed the foundational work for Epic 5 (Stories 5.1 through 5.8), encompassing background asset management, company form defaults, schema parity, preview/production governance, publish request workflows, and admin reviews. This story focuses on tying it all together through a full end-to-end user acceptance test to ensure the system is production-ready.

architectural-constraints.constraint: No new features should be introduced unless absolutely necessary to unblock a core workflow.
All bug fixes must respect the existing patterns for assets, defaults, and the shared resolver.

dependencies.dependency: Story 5.8 (Admin Review & Publish + Activation) is complete and merged.
